COMPLEX SENTENCE

1. NOUN CLAUSE (संज्ञा उपवाक्य)
→ जो वाक्य में Noun का कार्य करे।
पहचान: that, what, who, whether आदि

Example:
I know that he is honest.

20 Examples:
1. I know that he is honest.
2. I believe that she will win.
3. He said that he was busy.
4. We hope that you will come.
5. I don't know where he lives.
6. Tell me what you want.
7. I wonder why she is crying.
8. Do you know who wrote this letter?
9. The fact is that he failed.
10. I heard that they got married.
11. She asked whether I was ready.
12. Nobody knows when he will arrive.
13. I remember what he said.
14. It is certain that he will pass.
15. I understand why you are upset.
16. Please tell me who called.
17. We discovered that the door was open.
18. I cannot decide which book to buy.
19. The problem is that we are late.
20. I know how he solved the question.

2. ADJECTIVE / RELATIVE CLAUSE (विशेषण उपवाक्य)
→ जो किसी Noun/Pronoun की विशेषता बताए।
पहचान: who, whom, whose, which, that

Example:
The boy who is standing there is my brother.

20 Examples:
1. The boy who is standing there is my brother.
2. I met a girl who speaks French.
3. This is the book that I bought yesterday.
4. The man who helped me was kind.
5. The house which stands on the hill is beautiful.
6. The student whose notebook is lost is absent.
7. I know the person who won the race.
8. The car that he purchased is expensive.
9. The teacher who teaches us English is strict.
10. The dog which barked all night is sleeping.
11. The woman whose purse was stolen called the police.
12. The pen that you gave me is blue.
13. The city which we visited was crowded.
14. The player who scored the goal was happy.
15. The movie that we watched was interesting.
16. The child who broke the glass apologized.
17. The shop which sells books is closed.
18. The man whose son is a doctor lives nearby.
19. The road that leads to the village is narrow.
20. The girl who won the prize is my cousin.

--------------------------------------------------

3. ADVERB CLAUSE (क्रिया-विशेषण उपवाक्य)
→ जो Verb, Adjective या Adverb की विशेषता बताए।
पहचान: when, where, because, if, although, since, while, before, after आदि

Example:
I stayed at home because it was raining.

20 Examples:
1. I stayed at home because it was raining.
2. When the bell rang, the students left.
3. If you work hard, you will succeed.
4. Although he is poor, he is honest.
5. She smiled when she saw me.
6. Since it was late, we went home.
7. Before you leave, lock the door.
8. After he finished his work, he rested.
9. While I was studying, my friend called.
10. Wherever you go, I will follow you.
11. As soon as the train arrived, we boarded it.
12. Because she was tired, she slept early.
13. Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
14. Though he tried hard, he failed.
15. Whenever I meet him, he greets me warmly.
16. Where there is a will, there is a way.
17. Until the teacher came, the class was noisy.
18. As the sun set, the sky turned red.
19. Even if it rains, we will play.
20. So that he could pass, he studied day and night.

--------------------------------------------------

TRICK:

Noun Clause
→ "क्या? कौन? किसे? क्या बात?"
→ Clause = Noun

Adjective/Relative Clause
→ "कैसा? कौन-सा? किसका?"
→ Clause = Adjective

Adverb Clause
→ "कब? कहाँ? क्यों? कैसे? किस शर्त पर?"
→ Clause = Adverb

SHORT TRICK:
Noun Clause     → Noun का काम
Adjective Clause → Noun की विशेषता
Adverb Clause   → Verb की विशेषता
